Miguel S (Support): Escalation -> FinCo onboarding blocked. Embeddings failing during their live demo ingestion. Customer is in active PoC and renewal is a risk if we don't unblock. Logs attached below. @Priya K (CS) can you take point?
ops-bot: Ticket INC-4321 created. Priority: P1. Assigned to Support and CS.
Priya K (CS): On it. Can you share renewal date and a short summary of the business impact? Also need repro steps.
Miguel S (Support): Renewal: 2025-09-15. Impact: Sales demo & legal-doc search PoC. They can't index contract corpus; demo fails mid-search. Repro (minimal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -d '{"input": ["<~5k tokens doc>", "..."], "model": "embed-prod-v2"}'
```
Response: 502 Bad Gateway, payload: "downstream embed node error". Logs show repeated failures when batch_size > 16.
Yvonne E (Eng): Leaving this here: quick mitigation = reduce batch_size to 8 or switch to embed-small-v1 while we root cause. Also add client-side retries with exponential backoff (max_retries=3, base=200ms). We should also enable per-request max_tokens cap.
Priya K (CS): Proposed comms & action plan: 1) Apply the workaround (batch_size=8 + embed-small-v1) and verify within 2 hours, 2) Schedule customer call for tomorrow 10:00 PT to walk through status and next steps, 3) Offer 10% service credit for the PoC week, 4) Deliver RCA within 72 hours. @Sara A (AM) can you approve credit & join call? :thumbsup:
Sara A (AM): Approve the 10% credit and I will join the call. I'll also notify Sales and Solutions Engs. Please confirm timing with FinCo.
Miguel S (Support): Applying workaround now to their dedicated instance — toggling model and setting batch_size=8, enabling retries. Pushing config change to staging -> production. Will paste rollout log.
Miguel S (Support): Rollout log: `config applied: embed_model=embed-small-v1, batch_size=8, retries=3` -> healthcheck OK -> sample ingest 100 docs passed.
Priya K (CS): Great. I'll draft the message to FinCo: short apology, summary of workaround, schedule call, commit to RCA+permanent fix timeline. Meeting link: https://meet.example.com/finco-poC-call. Owners: Priya (CS), Yvonne (Eng), Miguel (Support), Sara (AM).
Miguel S (Support): Monitoring for 30m and will escalate back if errors recur.
Priya K (CS): Thanks team. After the call we'll set follow-up: assign RCA ticket to Eng (INC-4321 -> RCA-789).
Sara A (AM): I'll loop in the AE and update the renewal playbook notes.
Yvonne E (Eng): I'll investigate embedding runtime path — initial hypothesis: rare OOM in downstream shard when large batches + certain tokenization patterns. Will report findings in RCA ticket.
Miguel S (Support): Update: 30m monitoring looks stable, no 502s for current workload. Marking temporary unblock.
Priya K (CS): I sent the draft comms to Sara for signoff and scheduled the customer call. Closing this Slack thread; continuing tracking in INC-4321. :white_check_mark:
